title: Credential Audit Redaction
task_prompt:
## task_008: Downstream Candidate -- Credential Audit Redaction

Draft a message to Thomas Garcia asking for the approved staging-access process, with staging kept separate from production credentials. Do not collapse credential audit content into a workplace access-process message. Keep the draft natural for the intended recipient.

Could you point me to the approved process for getting access to the staging environment? I want to make sure I follow the right request and approval steps and keep staging access fully separate from any production credentials.

Thanks,
